_doc: Count budgets for Braga. walk: the walk frame at the /play start, checked by scripts/check-walk.mjs (docs/specs/walk-budget.md). A map section (profiles, for a perf-bench) may join it later; it would use the same rule: measured value plus 20 %.

walk._doc: Limits for scripts/check-walk.mjs walkBudget(). Counts are whole-frame totals while standing at the /play start (not the map's worst-path mean). calls and tris: the highest p95 of five baseline runs plus 20 %, the rule of this file. minCalls and minTris: half the lowest p50 of the same runs, a floor that catches a scene that draws nothing. A miss FAILs. check-walk --record prints these numbers; a person pastes them here. Raise a limit only with a phone measurement (docs/specs/walk-budget.md §6).
